items.headline:
U.S. CONSUMER SPENDING SURGES AS CORE INFLATION COOLS

Inflation-adjusted U.S. consumer spending jumped 0.6% in August, its strongest monthly increase since March 2025.

Meanwhile, the Fed’s preferred inflation gauge rose 0.3% MoM, with core PCE increasing just 0.2%.

Resilient
items.author: DeItaone

items.headline:
SOFTER U.S. INFLATION CUTS FED HIKE ODDS

August core PCE fell to 3.0% YoY vs. 3.3% expected, while headline PCE came in at 3.4% vs. 3.7% forecast.

Q2 GDP was revised higher to 2.2% from 1.5%.

Kalshi now prices a 65% chance of no October Fed hike, versus 31% for a 25bp
